DKK1.existing_programs: Anti-DKK1 monoclonal antibodies (e.g. BHQ880/domesumab) trialed in myeloma bone disease; DKK1 peptide vaccine explored in precursor conditions at Dana-Farber; canonical Wnt/bone-disease axis in MM.
DKK1.safety_concerns: Low normal-tissue expression (tissue enhanced); secreted; Wnt antagonism role in bone - watch bone homeostasis effects.
DKK1.rationale: Canonical MM bone-disease driver, secreted, low normal expression, existing antibody and vaccine programs validate immunogenicity and feasibility.

CD200.existing_programs: Samalizumab (anti-CD200 mAb) trialed in MM; CD200-CD200R axis is an established immune-evasion checkpoint in MM; CAR/bispecific interest.
CD200.safety_concerns: Expressed on macrophages/endothelium and some normal hematopoietic cells; immune-modulatory target so watch myelosuppression.
CD200.rationale: Surface immune-evasion molecule up in neoplastic plasma cells (also significant in the paired within-patient contrast); existing clinical antibody program validates the target.

HGF.existing_programs: HGF/MET axis implicated in MM growth and bone disease; anti-HGF (rilotumumab) and MET inhibitors developed in other cancers.
HGF.safety_concerns: Plasma protein from liver; liver regeneration and wound healing roles; tissue-enriched so moderate risk.
HGF.rationale: Secreted growth factor strongly up in SMM neoplastic cells with high patient prevalence; druggable axis with existing clinical antibodies.

NCAM1.existing_programs: CD56 is a classic MM surface marker (esp. t(11;14)); lorvotuzumab mertansine (anti-NCAM1 ADC) trialed in MM; CAR-NK/CAR-T programs exist.
NCAM1.safety_concerns: Broad neural expression (brain, peripheral neurons) - T-cell targeting risks neurological autoimmunity; antibody-based approaches safer.
NCAM1.rationale: Well-validated MM surface antigen with prior clinical programs, but neural expression is a real safety caveat for a T-cell vaccine.

CADM1.existing_programs: Plasma-cell adhesion molecule; described as a T-cell recognition target in adult T-cell leukemia; less developed in MM specifically.
CADM1.safety_concerns: Tissue enhanced with testis/brain expression; surface protein on normal plasma cells at 11%.
CADM1.rationale: Surface adhesion molecule with the highest neoplastic-cell fraction in the shortlist (38% vs 11% normal) and paired-contrast support.

FCRLA.existing_programs: Fc receptor-like family restricted to B/plasma cell lineage; no major therapeutic programs; limited immunogenicity data.
FCRLA.safety_concerns: Lymphoid-restricted (good), but 16% of normal plasma cells express it - some on-target/off-tumor risk to normal PC.
FCRLA.rationale: Lineage-restricted with the highest neoplastic expression fraction (43%) and strong prevalence; specificity to plasma cells rather than tumor mutation is the main limitation.

CCND1.existing_programs: Cyclin D1-IGH translocation defines t(11;14) MM; central MM biology (all MM dysregulate one cyclin D); peptide/RTL vaccines explored preclinically.
CCND1.safety_concerns: Cell-cycle essential (DepMap caution); expressed in proliferating normal tissues; tolerance likely strong.
CCND1.rationale: Strongest DE signal in the dataset (log2FC 8.7, 85% of patients) and canonical MM oncogene, but broad proliferation-linked expression caps the safety score.

MYEOV.existing_programs: Overexpressed at 11q13 alongside CCND1 in MM; proposed oncogene in myeloma; no therapeutic programs.
MYEOV.safety_concerns: Poorly characterized protein; tissue enhanced; low normal-PC expression (5%).
MYEOV.rationale: MM-associated gene with high prevalence and good specificity, but weak functional/literature characterization limits confidence.

CD1D.existing_programs: CD1d/lipid-antigen and NKT-activation approaches (alpha-GalCer) explored in MM; CD1d on MM cells described.
CD1D.safety_concerns: Group enriched (immune tissues); presents lipids rather than being a classic peptide target.
CD1D.rationale: Immunologically interesting antigen-presenting molecule up in neoplastic PCs, but its lipid-presentation biology does not map cleanly onto peptide/HLA-I vaccination.

FRZB.existing_programs: Secreted Wnt antagonist implicated in MM bone disease; no direct therapeutic programs.
FRZB.rationale: Secreted Wnt-axis protein with decent prevalence; moderate evidence base in MM bone biology.

ST3GAL6.existing_programs: Plasma-cell sialyltransferase; ST3GAL6-MMP1 axis described in MM cell migration; no therapeutic programs.
ST3GAL6.safety_concerns: Golgi enzyme; tissue enhanced; 8% normal PC expression.
ST3GAL6.rationale: MM-relevant enzyme with good HLA coverage (24/27 alleles) and prevalence, but intracellular/Golgi and modest fold-change.

LAMP5.existing_programs: Hematopoietic lysosomal protein; no MM-specific programs known.
LAMP5.rationale: Decent DE and prevalence with lymphoid restriction, but thin literature support.

DHRS9.existing_programs: Retinaldehyde dehydrogenase in antigen-presenting cells; no MM programs.
DHRS9.safety_concerns: Tissue enhanced (retina, prostate, gut); retinal expression warrants caution.
DHRS9.rationale: Moderate DE signal; retinal tissue expression is a safety flag for T-cell targeting.

MLLT3.existing_programs: KMT2A fusion partner in leukemia; hematopoietic gene; no MM programs.
MLLT3.safety_concerns: Broad hematopoietic expression; low tissue specificity.
MLLT3.rationale: Consistent DE across contrasts and high prevalence, but broad expression and housekeeping-adjacent function.

CKS2.existing_programs: CKS1B (paralog) is the well-known 1q21 MM amplicon driver; CKS2 less established in MM.
CKS2.rationale: Cell-cycle gene with SMM DE support; the MM literature centers on CKS1B rather than CKS2.

POU2F2.existing_programs: B-cell transcription factor; no MM therapeutic programs.
POU2F2.rationale: Lineage TF with modest DE; specificity to B cells limits safety margin.

EDNRB.existing_programs: Endothelin-B receptor; endothelin axis in MM bone disease; ET receptor antagonists exist clinically (pulmonary hypertension).
EDNRB.safety_concerns: Vascular/endothelial expression; surface receptor on normal vasculature.
EDNRB.rationale: Surface receptor up in neoplastic PCs with good HLA coverage, but endothelial expression is a safety concern.

IFI27.safety_concerns: Induced by IFN in virtually all cells during infection/inflammation - autoimmune risk.
IFI27.rationale: Interferon-signature gene; expression is inflammation-driven rather than tumor-specific.

IFITM1.existing_programs: IFITM family; some cancer immunotherapy interest; no MM programs.
IFITM1.rationale: Interferon signature; moderate specificity in this dataset but inflammation-driven expression elsewhere.

SPN.existing_programs: CD43 is a pan-leukocyte marker; some CAR interest in AML.
SPN.safety_concerns: All leukocytes express CD43 - poor safety margin.
SPN.rationale: Pan-leukocyte surface protein; too broad for a T-cell vaccine.

TNFSF10.existing_programs: TRAIL receptor agonists trialed in cancer.

SLC1A5.existing_programs: Glutamine transporter; CAR-T target in AML; metabolic therapy interest.
SLC1A5.safety_concerns: Broad metabolic expression (brain, muscle); not DE in SMM here (log2FC 0.2).
SLC1A5.rationale: Surface metabolic target with existing programs, but essentially not differentially expressed in SMM in this dataset.

NEB.existing_programs: Giant muscle structural protein; none relevant.
NEB.safety_concerns: Cardiac/skeletal muscle expression - serious safety risk; epitope count is a length artifact (8525 aa).
NEB.rationale: Enormous protein generates many binders trivially; muscle expression and no MM biology make it unattractive.

TUBB.rationale: Housekeeping gene; fails specificity and essentiality checks.

TXN.rationale: Housekeeping gene; fails specificity and essentiality checks.

CNTN5.safety_concerns: Neural tissue expression - neurological autoimmunity risk.
CNTN5.rationale: Large neural adhesion protein; many binders reflect length; neural safety risk.

SYT1.rationale: Neuronal protein; poor safety for T-cell targeting.

LSAMP.existing_programs: Neuronal adhesion; deletions in some cancers.

CCDC144A.rationale: Poorly characterized; epitope count reflects 1427 aa length.

FAM133A.rationale: Poorly characterized; strong DE but no literature support.

PRR15.rationale: Poorly characterized; strong DE but few HLA binders (6/27 alleles).

NOL4.rationale: Strong DE and good HLA coverage but no literature support.

TBXAS1.safety_concerns: Broadly expressed across myeloid lineage; lymphoid-restricted at tissue level but not tumour-restricted.
TBXAS1.rationale: Thromboxane A synthase; myeloid/platelet enzyme. Prostanoid signalling described in marrow microenvironment, but no myeloma-directed program.

HERC5.safety_concerns: IFN-inducible in most cell types during infection or inflammation - the same autoimmune concern as IFI6/MX1.
HERC5.rationale: ISG15 E3 ligase, interferon-induced. Not previously described as a myeloma marker; the interferon-inducible class is a recurring false positive in this dataset.

CPQ.safety_concerns: HPA protein staining is highest in kidney and liver, which contradicts the RNA tier and would disqualify it.
CPQ.rationale: Carboxypeptidase Q; lysosomal/secreted peptidase. No myeloma literature.

HEY2.safety_concerns: Vascular and cardiac developmental role; blood-vessel outlier at RNA level.
HEY2.rationale: Notch effector transcription factor. Notch signalling has myeloma-microenvironment literature, but HEY2 itself is not an established marker.

IGF1.existing_programs: IGF1R-directed antibodies (figitumumab, AVE1642) have been evaluated clinically in myeloma - the receptor, not the ligand.
IGF1.safety_concerns: Broadly expressed, low tissue specificity; systemic endocrine role makes it a poor vaccine antigen despite strong pathway literature.
IGF1.rationale: IGF1/IGF1R signalling is one of the better-characterised survival pathways in myeloma. Note the clinical agents target the receptor; IGF1 itself is the ligand.

DST.safety_concerns: Broad expression; neural and muscle isoforms.
DST.rationale: Dystonin, a giant cytoskeletal linker. No myeloma literature; large protein, so epitope counts need length correction.

RBMS1.rationale: Single-stranded DNA/RNA binding protein. No myeloma-specific literature.

EID1.rationale: EP300-interacting inhibitor of differentiation. Housekeeping-adjacent; no myeloma literature.

LENG1.rationale: Leukocyte receptor cluster member; essentially uncharacterised.

MCC.rationale: 'Mutated in colorectal cancer' - Wnt-pathway associated, but no myeloma literature.

MFAP3L.rationale: Microfibril-associated protein 3-like; uncharacterised in haematological malignancy.

GADD45GIP1.rationale: GADD45G-interacting protein / mitochondrial ribosomal associated. Housekeeping-adjacent.

RPL36A.rationale: Ribosomal protein. This is the housekeeping class the specificity term exists to suppress.

TNS3.rationale: Tensin 3, focal adhesion protein. No myeloma literature.

KIAA1524.rationale: CIP2A, an inhibitor of PP2A. Oncogenic in several solid tumours, but not established as a myeloma marker.

PTTG1.safety_concerns: Expressed in any proliferating tissue - testis and bone marrow outliers.
PTTG1.rationale: Securin; regulates sister-chromatid separation. A generic proliferation marker across cancers rather than a myeloma-specific antigen.

STARD5.rationale: StAR-related lipid transfer protein. No myeloma literature.

THG1L.rationale: tRNA-histidine guanylyltransferase; core tRNA-processing machinery. This is the housekeeping class the confidence-D gate exists to remove.

KIT.existing_programs: none as an antigen; imatinib and other KIT kinase inhibitors have been evaluated in myeloma, but targeting the kinase rather than the surface antigen
KIT.safety_concerns: Expressed on haematopoietic stem/progenitor cells, mast cells and interstitial cells of Cajal - on-target damage to HSCs is the major concern.
KIT.rationale: CD117/KIT is an established myeloma plasma-cell marker used routinely in diagnostic flow cytometry, expressed on a substantial subset of cases. Genuine myeloma biology, though no antigen-directed program.

TMEM173.existing_programs: STING agonists have been evaluated in cancer immunotherapy including myeloma models, but as adjuvants that engage the pathway, not as antigens
TMEM173.safety_concerns: Ubiquitous innate-immune expression; breaking tolerance to STING would impair antiviral immunity.
TMEM173.rationale: STING is an innate-immune adaptor. Its myeloma literature concerns pathway agonism to boost immunity, which is a different use from being a vaccine antigen.

TJP1.safety_concerns: Broad epithelial expression at tight junctions.
TJP1.rationale: ZO-1 tight-junction protein. TJP1 expression has been reported to predict proteasome-inhibitor sensitivity in myeloma, so there is genuine disease-related literature, though not as a target.

P2RX1.safety_concerns: Platelet and smooth-muscle expression - bleeding risk if targeted.
P2RX1.rationale: Purinergic P2X1 receptor; platelet and immune-cell expression. Not described as a myeloma marker.

RP11-219A15.1.rationale: Uncharacterised lncRNA locus; no protein product, so it cannot be a peptide-vaccine target.
